responsibility: Implements the parsing and validation core for SHORTREAL textual conversion. It owns the finite-state scanner for signed fixed and scientific notation, classifies input strings with ConvTypes results, converts validated text to SHORTREAL through dtoa.strtod, raises a dedicated EXCEPTIONS source for invalid or out-of-range values, and computes formatted output lengths by rendering through ConvStringShort, making it the low-level conversion engine behind ShortStr and related short-real I/O.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the executable conversion engine for ShortConv; unlike the .def specification, it contains the finite-state scanner, dtoa-based parsing, exception raising, and length computation logic.
